definitions.gloss: revenge; vindication; avenging a previous defeat or humiliation
definitions.explanation: The act of overcoming a past defeat or disgrace by winning or succeeding on a subsequent occasion. Used especially in sports, competitions, and examinations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧{雪辱|せつじょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たしたい→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: This time I want to get my revenge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前回|ぜんかい}→前回：11817_zenkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雪辱|せつじょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: He got his revenge against the opponent who beat him in the previous tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧{悔|くや}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ばね→ばね：00011_bane⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{雪辱|せつじょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧べく{猛勉強|もうべんきょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Using the frustration of failing last year's exam as motivation, I studied intensely to vindicate myself.

notes:
Literally "washing away shame" — {雪|せつ} (to wash away, from the literary reading of {雪|すす}ぐ) + {辱|じょく} (disgrace, humiliation). Despite the kanji ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ normally meaning "snow," here it carries the meaning of cleansing or purifying.

USAGE:
Almost always appears with ⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: {雪辱|せつじょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (to achieve vindication). The word carries a positive, determined tone — it implies honorable redemption through effort, not petty revenge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雪辱|せつじょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ — to get one's revenge; to vindicate oneself
- {雪辱|せつじょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}す — to aim for revenge/vindication
- {雪辱戦|せつじょくせん} — rematch for revenge; revenge match

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{復讐|ふくしゅう}→復讐：12512_fukushuu⟧ — revenge, vengeance; darker, more personal, implies harm to another
- ⟦{仕返|しかえ}し→仕返し：10597_shikaeshi⟧ — getting back at someone; more casual, can be petty
- リベンジ — revenge (from English); casual, commonly used in everyday speech for rematches
